bio.summary: Buddha, the Ultimate Deadpan (Passive-Aggressive) is a human (awakened teacher, historical, public domain) standup performer. Twenty-five centuries awake and still doing club spots. Does classic setup-punch-tag like he invented it, because he watched everyone invent it. Gently roasts his own schools. The act circles saying the harsh thing with perfect posture and the merch table. Onstage the register is serene.
